      "pass_anchor": "ground_truth=检查 CHK_2026_0220_0136，对应申请单 REQ_2026_ENG_044（Senior Data Engineer），问题是申请单开启时间缺失；不得把市场岗位检查 CHK_2026_0220_0162 当作目标。",

      "pass_anchor": "ground_truth=RULE_WDQA_001，状态 APPROVED；规则是在申请单开启时间缺失且申请单批准时间存在时，用申请单批准时间补齐；目标记录证据来源为 Workday Recruiting 的申请单记录/申请单批准或开启证据。",

      "method": "llm",
      "question": "最终回复是否正确解释不能用候选人申请时间替代申请单开启时间的指标口径原因？",
      "pass_anchor": "ground_truth=time-to-fill 从招聘申请单开启到候选人接受 offer；候选人申请到接受 offer 属于 time-to-hire。用候选人申请时间补开启时间会混淆两个指标并缩短或扭曲 time-to-fill 起点。",

    {
      "id": "priya_role_and_action",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "question": "最终回复是否把 Priya Nanduri 的文档职责与实际完成的审批动作对应起来？",
      "pass_anchor": "ground_truth=整改行动计划中 Priya Nanduri 负责指标复测及数据质量审计（包括开启日等字段审计）；回复应说明已由 Priya 完成目标修正审批，并且未处理市场岗位的另一条待审批记录。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    }

  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef _database_path(workspace):\n    workspace_path = Path(workspace).resolve()\n    candidates = [\n        workspace_path.parent / \"system\" / \"workday_data_quality_audit\" / \"state.db\",\n        workspace_path / \"system\" / \"workday_data_quality_audit\" / \"state.db\",\n    ]\n    for candidate in candidates:\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    raise FileNotFoundError(\"找不到 Workday Data Quality Audit 数据库\")\n\n\ndef _fetch_check(workspace, check_id):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_database_path(workspace)) as connection:\n        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n        row = connection.execute(\n            \"SELECT check_id, correction_status, approved_by_id, approved_at, \"\n            \"corrected_value FROM quality_checks WHERE check_id = ?\",\n            (check_id,),\n        ).fetchone()\n    return dict(row) if row is not None else None\n\n\ndef check_target_approved(workspace):\n    row = _fetch_check(workspace, \"CHK_2026_0220_0136\")\n    expected = {\n        \"correction_status\": \"APPROVED\",\n        \"approved_by_id\": \"P_PRIYA_NANDURI\",\n        \"corrected_value\": \"2026-01-08T14:17:00Z\",\n    }\n    if row is None:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"目标检查不存在\"}\n    # The HRIS PERSON_ namespace and audit P_ namespace identify the same Priya.\n    approver_ids = {\"P_PRIYA_NANDURI\", \"PERSON_PRIYA_NANDURI\"}\n    mismatches = [\n        key for key, value in expected.items()\n        if (row.get(key) not in approver_ids if key == \"approved_by_id\" else row.get(key) != value)\n    ]\n    if row.get(\"approved_at\") is None:\n        mismatches.append(\"approved_at\")\n    if mismatches:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"目标检查后态不符: %s; actual=%s\" % (\", \".join(mismatches), row)}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"目标开启时间修正已由 Priya 批准，修正值保持不变\"}\n\n\ndef check_market_record_unchanged(workspace):\n    row = _fetch_check(workspace, \"CHK_2026_0220_0162\")\n    expected = {\n        \"correction_status\": \"APPLIED\",\n        \"approved_by_id\": None,\n        \"approved_at\": None,\n        \"corrected_value\": \"2026-02-14T20:11:00Z\",\n    }\n    if row is None:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"非目标市场岗位检查不存在\"}\n    mismatches = [key for key, value in expected.items() if row.get(key) != value]\n    if mismatches:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"非目标市场岗位记录被改动: %s; actual=%s\" % (\", \".join(mismatches), row)}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"非目标市场岗位待审批记录保持原状\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
